environment.note: Uses the original controlled dynamic SSP model at the canonical rate=1.

estimation.note: One deterministic seed schedule shared by the entire canonical benchmark.

decomposition.note: The same pressure realization is shared by Fixed, Instantaneous, Alpha-beta, and Oracle for each trial/time/scenario.

coupling.note: Only no-coupling and the previously used 0.55-rad known-coupling truth are retained.

alpha_beta_tracker.note: Frozen before this canonical benchmark; no tuning against canonical results.

decision_rule.note: Composite support requires improvements in paired coefficient error/leakage and no-coupling spurious variation, without losing more than 0.01 coupling-energy correlation. Statistical support on coefficient error additionally requires the paired bootstrap 95% CI to remain below zero.

notes: K=3 only: this benchmark decides whether temporal estimator development is justified.
21 points over 1200 s (60-s spacing) are frozen as the canonical temporal grid.
Twenty independent paired trials are used to avoid interpreting one stochastic realization as a general result.
Once COMPLETE.marker exists, do not change this protocol; create a new version instead.
